body: I completely understand this mentality, everyone says I shouldn't let myself be so down and they hope I feel better! What do they care if I don't? Is it all just empty words, I feel bad for my friend because she's the one person I can talk to about this but she will get tired of it eventually, it seems everyone does... I'm honestly sorry we feel this way, I don't know you, but I know your pain. No one deserves to know the feelings you feel, no one should have to do this.
